result.note: Tested the assembly strengths of the three legislatures voting in the opening phase of the April 2026 elections. These are durable structural facts.

questions.prompt: Consider the following pairs of legislatures that voted on 9 April 2026 in the opening phase of the assembly elections, and the number of seats contested:
questions.ask: How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.explain: All three are correct: Assam has 126 seats, Kerala 140 and Puducherry 30, for a total of 296 in the first phase. Tamil Nadu and West Bengal voted later in April, and counting for all five assemblies was set for 4 May 2026.
questions.source: A total of 296 seats are in play: 126 in Assam, 140 in Kerala, and 30 in Puducherry.
